description: Create a price experiment in draft. It needs two to ten variants, one named control, each with a price; weights are optional but must then be on every variant: relative for two variants, whole percentages adding up to 100 for more. Needs a Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

key.description: A key for the experiment: lowercase letters, digits and underscores only.

target_sample_size.description: How many buyers to reach before reading a winner.

name.description: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.

name: create_experiment
